title: When does adding a validator model beat a single model on its own?
summary: Across 297 graded answers, we tested whether pairing a writer model (Gemma 12B or Gemma 26B-A4B) with a separate Qwen 14B validator model and stricter 'cite or abstain' instructions beats running the writer model alone.
takeaway: A separate validator model helps weaker or more error-prone writers (cutting unsafe answers from 2 to 0 on the 26B-A4B setup and adding ~3 points), but does not improve an already-safe 12B model (~81/100 with zero unsafe answers on its own). Overly strict 'cite or abstain' rules made the 12B model too cautious.
